abstract: Accent conversion (AC) aims to transform accent-related acoustic characteristics of the source speech to a target accent while preserving linguistic content and speaker identity. Unlike conventional generative AC models, the retrieval-based ones, which employ k-nearest neighbors (kNN) to directly retrieve acoustic features from target-accent speech and so do not need source-accent speech during training, are more effective. However, existing retrieval-based AC frameworks face three issues: limited intelligibility due to incomplete phoneme coverage from sequential matching pool construction, limited adaptability to source speech variations, and low spectral continuity from coarse-grained style modulation. To address these limitations, we propose Anisotropy-Aware Adaptive k-Nearest Neighbor Accent Conversion (AA-kNN-AC), an enhanced retrieval-based AC model. First, we design a phoneme coverage-based matching pool construction strategy, employing greedy selection with diversity-aware scoring to achieve balanced and near-complete phonetic representation under limited target accent data. Second, we propose an anisotropy-aware adaptive kNN retrieval mechanism that dynamically determines the neighborhood size according to the singular value decomposition (SVD)-based anisotropy analysis, enhancing adaptability to source speech variations. Third, we present a progressive Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN)-based fine-grained decoder by integrating temporal up-sampling within AdaIN blocks, enhancing spectral continuity of the converted speech. Experimental results on the L2-ARCTIC and VCTK datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing retrieval-based and generative baselines in both objective and subjective evaluations, achieving high intelligibility, speaker similarity, and naturalness. Demo page is available at https://aa-knn-ac.github.io/demo/.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对检索式口音转换中匹配池覆盖不全、固定近邻数不适应局部几何、粗粒度风格调制损失细节的问题，AA-kkNN-AC 用音素覆盖选池、各向异性自适应近邻数和渐进式 AdaIN 解码器改进检索与重建，在 L2-ARCTIC 与 VCTK 上以固定美音匹配池实现更高可懂度和说话人相似度。
